svg.title: vLLM server initialization: API server process and EngineCore process
svg.desc: Numbered startup steps. In the API server process, vllm serve picks the single-server path, setup_server binds the socket, the CLI arguments become a VllmConfig, and AsyncLLM spawns the EngineCore process. EngineCore prepares the executor and model, the KV cache, and the scheduler, then reports READY. Only after READY does the API server build the app and start Uvicorn on the bound socket.
